raw_segments.text: I shan't stop," said Two Tails.
Then he stopped suddenly, and I heard a little whimper in the dark and knew that Vixen had
She knew as well as I did that if there is one thing in the world the elephant is more
afraid of than another it is a little barking dog.
So she stopped to bully Two Tails in his pickets and yapped round his big feet.
Go away, little dog, he said.
Don't snuff at my ankles or I'll kick at you.
Good little dog, nice little doggy then.
Go home, you yelping little beast.
Oh, why doesn't someone take her away?
She'll bite me in a minute.
